data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Experience menu, then Baggage allowance, then select cabin class) with cabin class as the parameter. The extra homepage-open and read-table steps are reasonable, and the only gap is that the cabin class options are listed loosely as tabs rather than links.
